semiconductor_relevance: High — ePAK Technologies specializes in precision-engineered packaging solutions for the semiconductor industry, focusing on wafer handling and transport.
summary: ePAK Technologies is a leading provider of wafer and semiconductor transfer and handling products, including FOUPs and shipping trays. With a global support network and advanced manufacturing capabilities, they serve top-tier semiconductor fabs and OEMs worldwide.
capabilities: 300mm Front Opening Unified Pod (FOUP) wafer carriers
Shipping trays and tape & reel products

regional_presence.China: ePAK has state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities in Shenzhen and Anhui.
regional_presence.Malaysia: The company also operates manufacturing in Penang, Malaysia.
regional_presence.United States: ePAK has its global headquarters and sales centers based in the US.
